changelog:
Dollar Platoon 1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Launches a peer-to-peer task payroll marketplace on Base L2, focused on micro-gigs funded in USDC.
- Enables clients to create gigs, distribute tasks through email/webhook, review proofs, and pay out on-chain.
- Implements a multi-dimensional, wallet-anchored reputation system as the sole enforcement mechanism; no dispute resolution.
- Supports managed and external wallets for users; all transactions require ETH gas on Base L2.
- Introduces a 10% platform fee on gigworker payouts (charged on top, not deducted).
- Integrates gig-level security tokens for inbound email and webhook protection.
- Platform is composable, allowing third-party publisher apps for task distribution.
summary: Peer-to-peer task payroll marketplace on Base L2. Clients create USDC-funded gigs, distribute tasks to gigworkers via email/webhook mailboxes, review proofs...
